title: Discover prior artifact names before reading a presumed ledger
failure_signature: A prior-phase inspection attempted to read a nonexistent x2 skill-runner ledger while later commands in the same shell still returned partial evidence.
trigger_preconditions: later successful output after an earlier path error
candidate_workaround: Enumerate bounded prior-phase filenames first, select the actual skill-build-use and runner-build-use receipts, and treat an earlier missing-path error as failure even when later commands succeed.
recurrence_guard: Never infer an artifact filename from a conceptual label; discover the bounded file surface and stop compound-command success from masking an earlier error.
rollback: Give the presumed-path read zero reuse credit, retain the missing-path witness, and use only the discovered exact filenames.
scope_boundary: Read-only inherited artifact discovery only; no production, scientific, authority, security-complete, or independent-reproduction credit.
